meta.name: commits
meta.description: Generate commit messages following Conventional Commits format. Use when creating commits, writing commit messages, or the user asks to commit changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按约定格式自动生成提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次写提交信息都要想格式
copy.tagline_en: Auto-generate commit messages in conventional format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to write commit messages consistently

howto.what: 当你需要提交代码时，Claude 会按照约定式提交格式生成提交信息。它自动选择合适类型（如 feat、fix 等）、范围（可选）和主体，并遵循最佳实践。
howto.when: 当你创建提交、写提交信息或要求提交变更时，Claude 会自动接管生成符合格式的提交信息。

say.text: 帮我生成提交信息，改动是添加了用户搜索功能
请为这次的bug修复写一个提交信息
生成一个refactor提交信息，主题是提取公共验证逻辑

howto.what_en: When you need to commit code, Claude generates commit messages following the Conventional Commits format. It selects appropriate type, scope, and body, adhering to best practices.
howto.when_en: When you create a commit, write a commit message, or ask to commit changes, Claude automatically takes over to generate a properly formatted commit message.

say_en.text: Generate a commit message for adding user search functionality
say_en.note: Outputs feat(ui): add user search functionality

say_en.text: Write a commit message for a bug fix
say_en.note: Outputs fix(api): resolve memory leak in connection pool

say_en.text: Create a refactor commit message with subject 'extract common validation logic'
say_en.note: Outputs refactor(api): extract common validation logic
